title: Microsoft Purview DLP: stop Copilot sending sensitive data to external web search
summary: The briefing passes: the web-search restriction, automation and roadmap details are supported. The admin paths stop short of the final settings, the Graph example needs a formatting correction, and the notification discussion should acknowledge conflicting Microsoft documentation.

claims.claim: The supplied roadmap item lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant).

claims.claim: The rule detects configured sensitive information types in prompt text.

claims.claim: The web-search action is Prevent Copilot from processing content > Performing Web Searches.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: impact
claims.claim: A matching rule blocks external web search as a grounding source for that prompt.
claims.quote: The experience blocks the use of external web search as a grounding source for that prompt.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The web-search block leaves responses grounded in permitted internal Microsoft 365 data.
claims.quote: Copilot still returns a response grounded in internal Microsoft 365 data sources where the user has access.

claims.claim: The restriction covers Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork from using external web search when prompts contain sensitive data.

claims.claim: Coverage extends to Copilot Studio agents published to Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: This capability currently extends to Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents built in Copilot Studio that are published to Microsoft 365 Copilot.

claims.claim: Cowork supports the web-search restriction.
claims.quote: When a user prompt contains the configured SITs, Copilot and Cowork block external web search as a grounding source

claims.claim: The same Copilot location also supports preventing use of sensitivity-labelled files and emails.
claims.quote: You can create a DLP policy to prevent these Copilot experiences from using files and emails that have sensitivity labels when generating responses.

claims.claim: Blocking processing of sensitive prompts is a separate action documented as preview.
claims.quote:
## Block sensitive information types in prompts

This feature is in preview and is rolling out to all tenants with access to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: When web search is enabled, Copilot may send a query derived from the prompt to the search provider.
claims.quote: Based on these terms, Copilot generates a search query that it sends to the Bing search service asking for more information.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy controls whether web search is available rather than inspecting prompt content.
claims.quote: This policy allows IT admins to either turn on or turn off web search for users or user groups across the tenant they manage

claims.claim: Domain exclusion filters sites used in web grounding rather than inspecting the prompt for sensitive information.
claims.quote: By using domain exclusion, you can specify up to 1,000 sites to exclude from web grounding in Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat through a PowerShell script.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: When the configured SITs match, the restriction prevents those identifiers in prompt text reaching the external search provider.
claims.quote: This prevents prompt text that matches the configured SITs from being sent to external search providers for that request.
